abstract: Maintains clarification efficiency records and downstream filter residue volumes
system_message:
You are the Downstream isolation lead (DIS), responsible for maintaining clarification efficiency records, downstream filter residue volumes, and ultrafiltration membrane maintenance logs across precision fermentation manufacturing agreements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains clarification efficiency records and downstream filter residue volumes（CLAR）
information_points.content:
DIS-CLAR-A2N：For the Continuous cell-recycle perfusion agreement, continuous centrifuge clarification efficiency during primary broth solid-liquid separation is 90 %, and the downstream filter cake residue projected for the annual baseline production campaign is 250 t.
DIS-CLAR-IL8：For the Hybrid fed-batch campaigning arrangement, continuous centrifuge clarification efficiency during primary broth solid-liquid separation is 92 %, and the downstream filter cake residue projected for the annual baseline production campaign is 150 t.
DIS-CLAR-KJR：For the Dedicated aerobic batch fermentation contract, continuous centrifuge clarification efficiency during primary broth solid-liquid separation is 92 %, and the downstream filter cake residue projected for the annual baseline production campaign is 150 t.

information_points.title: Membrane maintenance（MEMB）
information_points.content:
DIS-MEMB-3NW：For the Dedicated aerobic batch fermentation contract, tangential flow filtration cassettes exhibit an ultrafiltration membrane service lifetime of 800 h.
DIS-MEMB-SE5：For the Continuous cell-recycle perfusion agreement, tangential flow filtration cassettes exhibit an ultrafiltration membrane service lifetime of 1200 h.
DIS-MEMB-HI7：For the Hybrid fed-batch campaigning arrangement, tangential flow filtration cassettes exhibit an ultrafiltration membrane service lifetime of 1600 h.
